acceptance.1: main.py startup handler start_discovery_allocator_schedule runs the allocator daily (DISCOVERY_ALLOCATOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS default 86400) behind DISCOVERY_ALLOCATOR_ENABLED; the setting defaults to enabled (paper-only, cap 5) and DISCOVERY_ALLOCATOR_ENABLED=false turns it off; docker-compose.yml mounts the principal files and sets DISCOVERY_ALLOCATOR_TENANT_ID default tenant-dev
acceptance.2: each run appends a record to <data_dir>/discovery_allocator_runs.jsonl: admitted_candidates_seen/refs, bound[], skipped[], reason
acceptance.3: test_startup_schedule_runs_allocator_paper_only_cap_five: TestClient startup, 8 admitted x 8 personas, max_personas=99 -> exactly 5 bound, all paper
acceptance.5: Production ports (make_production_ports): persona reader (GET /api/personas, RESEARCH_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN), registry resolver (GET /api/registry/strategy-specs/{id}; admission rows are normalized to the approved inline StrategySpec, tenant/state/checksum verified, otherwise skipped with a named reason), durable binding reader (GET Capital /api/bindings, binding_id prefix pcb-discovery-, pending/active, tenant-filtered; RESEARCH_CAPITAL_SERVICE_TOKEN), persona_strategy_discovery scorer, BFF paper-capital provisioner (body includes currency=USD, ids stable per tenant/persona/spec so reruns adopt the same pool/binding). A provision failure keeps earlier bindings and records provision_failed per item; OwnerUnreachable mid-run stops and records the reason with bound retained.

known_limitation: Two additional READ-ONLY principals (persona viewer, capital-reader) were added beyond operator decision A (BFF operator token); flagged for reviewer/operator. A live containerized production-port run against real persona/capital/BFF services was not executed here; production-port behavior is proven by the real BFF request model and real PersonaProvisioningCoordinator with a fake owner transport.
